boundaries.current: Conditional decoded current safety under fifteen raw primitive/deployment premises; external PARAM-11-11 evidence-window sizing is assumed and immutable transport is derived. Image certificates contain no live footprint: actual fresh trace and pure statement binding derive it. H1 exports the postlanding S partition for legacy signals emitted from the modeled empty lane; predeployment SignalService data are absent. H2 whole-committee/overlap retention is above-checkpoint and excludes any rollback since fresh genesis, with no restart theorem. Complete semantic archive ancestry is stronger than an L+2-only guest; bounded suffix extraction is proved but accepted guest refinement is deferred. Profile restrictions include generation1 first switching landing, vacuous upstream extension, genesis risk, self-chain round0 honest agreement and empty accepted prior lists. Raw DAO histories require instrumented per-history authorization; a rollback is authorized only to the last trusted landing below a bad retained record (RECOV-8-28 as an external duty). Production/retarget/availability/launch refinements remain separate.
boundaries.recovery: Conditional decoded current recoverability (H4) under RecoveryPremises: H1's five fund premises, a strictly increasing L1 clock, catalogue byte hashing, assumed proof completeness (MODEL-1-1/1-2), payload availability for one to six blobs and usable final Unzen headers; and under the per-state LiveAt hypotheses: 48/256-bit headroom for the generation, recovery nonce, ruleset and checkpoint, one later L1 window block with a live committee, live rulesets (the current ones with the checkpoint on the current grid, or ruleset nextRules + 1 with no grid condition) and a live Unzen lane. EL execution, signatures and blobs come from these hypotheses existentially. A live ruleset gives some child for every parent, FI cursor, timestamp above the parent's, anchor and witness bytes a block producer picks, accepted only at those witness bytes and only for bodies that name the parent's hash, pay a fee share of 100 and carry the anchor's state root as parent beacon root; no EL, signer or DA implementation is modeled. The path is rollback-free with one recovery with no exclusions and no FI blanking: plain when the checkpoint is on the grid, otherwise structural with one change, K = 1, in ruleset nextRules + 1 (a K change needs a new ruleset, START-10.1-14e). That this recovery passes RECOV-8.3-3a is a fact about the path, not a statement of the rule. A trap witness reaches, under a failed verifier and after a rollback across a K change, an off-grid state from which no path without a rollback or a structural recovery lands; a structural recovery that installs a K whose grid holds the checkpoint leaves it, as SPEC 8.3 allows, and H4's path takes that exit with K = 1 when ruleset nextRules + 1 is live. Normal-operation liveness, adversarial scheduling, DAO transaction refinement and production/launch refinements remain separate.
